services.desc: This powerful at-home sauna blanket provides a full-body detox experience, offering high-quality wellness benefits that anyone can enjoy in the comfort of their own home. Infrared technology is a certain wavelength of light that is capable of heating up the body from the inside, creating a powerful detox. You simply wrap yourself inside our infrared blanket and allow the gentle and safe infrared heat warm up your body while you melt into relaxation and natural detoxification. You can use your sauna blanket daily! Enjoy a post-workout sweat to aid muscle and joint recovery, relax before bed for better sleep, or start your morning with a calming, centering session.
